content.text:
View A contains four remembered items. Upper is very likely a green triangle. Right is most likely a yellow square with a small chance of red and a small chance of circle. Lower is a blue cross with high certainty. Left is a red circle with very high certainty (tiny chance of square). The model provides no selection probabilities or recoverability estimates for A and gives no predicted effects of different commands, so it does not support claims about which item is currently attended, how reliably each can be accessed now or after steps, or whether attention can be redirected within A.

View B also contains four remembered items. Upper is a yellow square with high certainty. Right is a blue triangle with high certainty. Lower is a mostly green cross (small admixture of blue and yellow possible). Left is a red circle with very high certainty. As with A, there are no selection probabilities, recoverability values, or command-prediction rows for B, so the model does not support statements about current attention allocation or how attention would shift under different commands.
